title: No Test Net? I Built a Paper Trading Mode Instead | vitalii.no
description:
Pump.fun has no devnet or sandbox, so there's no safe place to test a trading strategy against real market conditions without either risking real SOL or building a fake simulation too simplistic to mean anything.

trader.ts now runs identical logic in both paper and live mode. In paper mode it fills orders against real DexScreener prices while applying a fixed 3% slippage and 1.5% fee model instead of calling PumpPortal, writing the resulting paper balance to D1 the same way a live fill would. Switching to real trading only requires sending /mode live CONFIRM in Telegram, which flips trader.ts to sign transactions through PumpPortal's trade-local endpoint and real Solana RPC calls — same code path, same risk and treasury checks, different execution backend.

The full eight-agent desk can now run against live market data for days in paper mode and produce a realistic equity curve, fees and slippage included, before the mode is ever switched to live.
